message.text: I'm noting that memo_relation records get deleted in both directions along with attachments, and I want to check whether reactions or comments are handled separately, perhaps comments are just memos linked via a COMMENT relation type. I should look at the DeleteMemo driver implementation to see if reactions are cleaned up via SQL cascade.

DeleteMemo only removes the memo row itself, so I need to check whether reactions cascade-delete via a foreign key constraint or end up orphaned, which means checking the reaction table's schema definition.
